blocking_defects.why_blocking: Sum of recurring obligations (42k+8k+10k+3k+5k+15k+15k=98k) exceeds monthly_fixed_obligations_inr=80k by 18k. This creates a fundamental budget inconsistency.
Minimum discretionary spending (45k) already exceeds food (15k) + shopping (13k) + travel (12k) = 40k by 5k. This creates an impossible baseline for discretionary spending.

Credit card usage for 30% of discretionary spending (85k*30%=25.5k) is plausible, but the high outstanding balance (140k) implies 140k/280k=50% utilization, which is inconsistent with the stated 'credit card used for 30% of discretionary spending' in realism_notes.
